facts.fact: BCEAO Instruction n° 008-05-2015 of 21 May 2015 governs e-money issuers in the UMOA; Instruction n° 020 of 8 October 2026 amends its articles 31 and 34 (caps on holdings and reloads, placement of float), in force 2 November 2026.
facts.system: BCEAO Instruction n° 008-05-2015 of 21 May 2015 on e-money issuers, amended by Instruction n° 020 of 2026
